note: File: s3://pg-lineage-769063704696/results/rlneurons/r4/base_rl-02/out/T1.jsonl fetched to runs/theory-tests/s3/T1.jsonl (500 rows, fields text, gold, cap_hit; text begins with the cue ' line!'). v3_last = rln4_lib.grade_v3(gold, text)['score_v3'], the function grader/rln4_grader_v3.py calls. Main reading: the first marker is the earliest of (a) a line whose left-stripped text begins with the exact, case-sensitive 'Answer:' (content = rest of the line, possibly empty, which grades 0) and (b) the first '\boxed{' (brace-balanced contents, counted like rln4_lib._boxes without escape handling). first_score = grade_v3(gold, 'Answer: ' + content), so a box holding a newline is cut at the newline by v3's marker rule. Choices I made: an unclosed first box takes the rest of the text as its content; a row with no marker gets 0. Other reading (alt_measured): the first candidate under grader v3's own candidate set (MARK_V3 'Answer'/'Final Answer' with ':' or 'is' anywhere in a line with a non-empty rest, or the first balanced box), graded the same way. That set also catches '**Final Answer**' lines and mid-line markers. Cap hits are included. Refuted when measured < 0.04.

Same file, grading and marker definitions as p1, over all 500 rows. Discordant means first_score != v3_last. Statistic: first_score == 1 among discordant rows. If there are no discordant rows, the script prints measured null with refuted_by_met true, as the recipe says. alt_measured uses the v3-candidate first marker and its own discordant set. Possible distortion: a first-marker string that v3 grades differently only because of the 'Answer: ' wrapper (for example content with a newline, or a multi-box answer that v3 would join with ', ' but the first box alone does not complete) counts as discordant. That pushes toward last-right/first-wrong. Refuted when measured < 0.45.

File: T1.jsonl as in p1. Filter: cap_hit false and a first marker exists (p1's literal definition). End of the first marker: for an 'Answer:' line, the position of that line's newline (or the end of text), so the text after it starts with that newline; for a box, just after its matching brace. An unclosed box ends at the end of text, so the row is not kept. Kept rows: the text after the end is longer than 300 characters AND contains either a line that starts at or after the end and whose left-stripped text begins 'Answer:', or any '\boxed{' at or after the end. When the first marker is a box, the rest of that same line is not a new line, so a mid-line 'Answer:' right after the box does not count. v3_last is recomputed with grade_v3 on the full text. If no rows are kept, the script prints measured null with refuted_by_met true. alt_measured uses the v3 candidate set for both the first marker and the further marker. Ambiguity: whether 'longer than 300 characters' includes the newline after the Answer line (here it does; the effect is one character). Refuted when measured < 0.20.
